shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head and torso
circular disc/rosette motif on the body
incised linear/banded patterning on the body
headgear or headdress on the figure
justification: Both show a humanoid figure with a headdress and a small circular disc motif set against the torso plus incised banding, but that is about as generic as anthropomorphic imagery gets. The differences dominate: B is a naturalistic profile relief of a bearded winged figure with articulated wings, coiffure and handheld objects, while A is a frontal, blocky, highly schematic monolithic figure with no wings, no discernible arms or attributes, and abstract surface markings — no shared conventions of rendering or composition.
